paper_description: Enabled enantioselective 1,4-addition of aryl/alkenyl halides to enones/aldimines, uncovering a novel mechanism of 'elementary 1,4-aryl addition' that bypasses canonical 1,2-migratory insertion.
Designed an H-bond donor that ionizes Ar–Pd(II)–X oxidative-addition complexes under mild conditions, enabling stereoselective intermolecular Heck and Heck-type couplings.
Employed acetic acid/indium powder to deliver stereoselective H/D transfer, a protocol now adopted for late-stage functionalization of complex targets.
